title: Hot chocolate / cocoa, dry mix, made with non-dairy milk

content.title: About
content.content: The dry mix for hot chocolate / cocoa is designed for quick preparation of a beverage using non‑dairy milk (soy, oat, almond, etc.). The mix contains cocoa powder, sugar, salt and flavorings, and is free from dairy, making it suitable for vegans and people with lactose intolerance.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The mix is usually packaged in an airtight pouch, preserving aroma and flavor for up to 12 months.
Cocoa powder is often alkalized (Dutch‑process) to give a darker colour and milder acidity.
Vegan hot chocolate mixes gained popularity in the 2000s alongside the rise of plant‑based milk alternatives.
Some blends include extra ingredients such as vanilla, cinnamon or sea salt for flavor variety.
A typical ratio (about 2 Tbsp mix to 250 ml non‑dairy milk) yields a thick, creamy drink.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Cocoa powder provides flavonoids that help combat free radicals and support cardiovascular health.

items.title: Lactose‑free
items.content: Suitable for people with lactose intolerance and those following a vegan diet.

items.title: Contains magnesium
items.content: Magnesium in cocoa supports normal muscle and nerve function.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Compared with traditional hot chocolate made with cow’s milk, a plant‑milk version usually contains less saturated fat.

items.title: Mood‑enhancing
items.content: Cocoa stimulates the production of serotonin and endorphins, which can improve mood.

items.title: Allergy to plant ingredients
items.content: Some mixes may contain soy or nut proteins that can trigger allergic reactions.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Many blends are sweetened; people monitoring blood sugar should choose unsweetened versions.

items.title: Caffeine and theobromine
items.content: Cocoa contains modest amounts of theobromine and caffeine, which may be undesirable in large amounts for caffeine‑sensitive individuals.

items.title: Temperature control
items.content: Over‑heating the plant milk can alter flavor and degrade some beneficial antioxidants.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Mix 2 Tbsp of the dry mix with 250 ml of hot (but not boiling) non‑dairy milk, whisk or blend until smooth and creamy. Optional additions include spices (cinnamon, vanilla), plant‑based whipped topping, or vegan marshmallows.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the dry mix in its original sealed pouch in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep the package tightly closed to prevent moisture absorption. Discard the mix if it develops a stale or moldy odor or changes colour.
